$comment: The road on /start (client/src/pages/Start.tsx): six steps in order, one sentence and one link each, then where the road goes on. Only pages that already exist. scripts/prerender-heads.mjs reads this file for the page's crawlable list, and start.test.tsx checks every link and count against the site's own data.

steps.title: Read the Gospel of John
steps.line: John has twenty-one chapters, so a chapter a day takes three weeks, and the Study Bible has notes on every one of them for the parts you don't follow yet.
steps.link: Open John in the Study Bible

steps.title: Learn to pray
steps.line: If nobody ever taught you how to pray, begin with five minutes a day and the prayer Jesus gave his followers, one line at a time.
steps.link: Eight Weeks of Learning to Pray

steps.title: Find a church
steps.line: This faith was never meant to be lived alone, so look for a faithful church, which isn't the same thing as a perfect one, and go more than once before you decide.

steps.title: Walk the first eight weeks
steps.line: Eight Weeks of Beginnings gives each week one focus, one small daily practice and one thing to read, and it gets to baptism, the old habits, and the doubts that come back.

steps.title: Learn what Christians believe
steps.line: The catechism teaches the faith in seventy-six short questions and answers, beginning with "Who made you?", and each one has an answer for an adult and a shorter one for a child.

steps.title: Go through it with someone
steps.line: New Believers is a five-session study on your first steps of faith, and it comes with a leader's guide, so you can ask a friend or a pastor to sit down and do it with you.
